newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds- Prices mixed, demand light.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds- Prices mixed, demand light.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mixed Tuesday, with some dealers raising offers in reaction to higher CBOT corn futures, dealers said.
"The sellers are still trying to talk it (prices) up because the board is up," said a Carolina dealer.

However, the Carolina dealer and several others said demand did not justify raising prices. There are ample supplies of corn, soymeal and soybean hulls, and buying was restrained amid ideas the ample supplies will push prices lower.
Some dealers said reduced run times at flour mills was helping support millfeed prices in some areas. Run times ranged from five to six days a week versus a normal six to seven days.
Portland millfeed offers were up $3.00 per ton at $115.00 from Monday. Dealers there said demand from Idaho and northern California was keeping supplies tight there.
